Connect to Wi‑Fi
Both devices need a reachable local network. Allow local access in your VPN.
Connect your devices
iPhone scans Pixel; Pixel scans Mac. Choosing a connection starts reception automatically.
Receiving will not start
Another app may be using the receiving connection, or the Wi‑Fi address may be unavailable. Follow the reason shown on Receive to try again.
Keep receiving in the background
Reception shows a system notification. Battery restrictions may interrupt background work.
After restarting your Pixel

BackupDuck resumes receiving after a restart when Android allows it. On Android 15 or later, tap the notification or open BackupDuck to resume. If you stopped receiving yourself, start it again on Receive.
Check the sending device
iPhone background time is limited. Keep the sender app open during large backups.
Received
The original files have arrived and passed a check that they are complete.
In your Pixel’s Photos
A copy has been saved to your Pixel’s Photos.
Upload with Google Photos
Google Photos uploads to your account separately. BackupDuck cannot confirm that upload has finished.
The space kept for originals and the space left free both limit new photos. Copies in Photos and temporary files also use space. Check Storage to see how space is used.
If saving to Photos fails, BackupDuck can try again from the originals. Freeing space in Google Photos does not remove originals kept inside BackupDuck.
Remove copies kept by BackupDuck

When this option is on in Storage, BackupDuck checks the copy in Photos before removing its temporary original. This does not confirm a cloud upload. Turning it off cannot restore files already removed.
Originals can be exported as a ZIP file. BackupDuck reads it back to check it before you can choose to remove eligible originals.
Try saving to Photos again
Check the reason shown under Photos → Needs you, then try saving again. A retry request does not mean the photo has already been saved.
Get a report for support
Open Settings → Diagnostics to export a report. It contains no photos or pairing codes; review it before sharing.
Open Settings → Check for updates. If Android says the update is from a different source, keep the installed app. Uninstalling or clearing its storage can remove originals kept inside BackupDuck.
